title: Customswords++
description: This adds 2 new custom swords to minecraft! They have custom abilities (In beta development. Don't expect them all to work). I will add more swords in the future! Created with MCreator
body:
This adds 3 new custom swords to Minecraft! They have custom abilities (In beta development. Don't expect them all to work). I will add more swords in the future! Created with MCreator.

**Darkness sword**: 50% chance to inflict the darkness effect to the target | 
  -Damage: 9.5
  -Durability: 1000
  ![The crafting recipe for the Darkness sword. Corners: Blackstone. Center: Obsidian. Sides: Netherite sword. Top and bottom: Wither skeleton skull .](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0f786657ef32a3988c32bc3783c9f1b5c495456e.png)
  
**Blood sword**: 31% chance to strike lightning on your target, and a 50% chance to stun the target (Freeze + Blind for a few seconds)
  -Damage: 10
  -Durability: 6978
  ![The crafting recipe for the blood sword. Corners: Nether brick. Center: Nether star. Sides: Netherite sword. Top and bottom: Redstone block. (https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2461cde3f67f86079e66835afa71c75218d0b798.png)

**God sword**: 50% chance to give the darkness effect to the target and strike lightning. 
  -Damage: 12
  -Durability: 4980
 ![The crafting recipe for the god sword. Corners: Gold block. Center: Nether star. Sides: Darkness sword. Top and bottom: Trident. (https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2f921980450ae417424e721f5aa6a63bff08f71a.png)



 To brew a darkness pot (1:35 Wither III, Weakness IV, Slowness IV, and Blindness) just use an awkward potion and a wither skeleton skull.
